claims.claim: Reviewers describe the game as exceptionally difficult, requiring memorization, high precision timing, and patience.

citations.review_text:
Geometry Dash is one of the greatest video games ever created, and there are many reasons why it deserves this title. At first glance, Geometry Dash might look like a simple game where a little square jumps over spikes and avoids obstacles. However, once someone starts playing, they quickly realize that there is much more to it than that. Geometry Dash is a game that combines music, creativity, skill, patience, determination, and entertainment into one amazing experience. It is a game that can keep people entertained for hours, challenge even the most experienced players, and bring together a massive community of people who all share a love for the game. Whether someone is a beginner playing their first level or an experienced player attempting an extremely difficult demon level, Geometry Dash has something enjoyable for almost everyone.

One of the biggest reasons Geometry Dash is such a good game is its incredible gameplay. The controls are extremely simple, which makes the game easy to understand. Most of the time, all a player needs to do is tap or click to make their character jump. Despite having such simple controls, the game can become incredibly challenging. Players have to learn the timing of every jump, understand different obstacles, and react quickly to avoid crashing. This combination of simple controls and difficult gameplay makes Geometry Dash extremely satisfying. Anyone can pick up the game and start playing, but mastering it takes a tremendous amount of practice. It is a game where players can always improve, no matter how experienced they already are.

Another amazing thing about Geometry Dash is its music. Music is one of the most important parts of the entire experience. Every level has music that matches its gameplay, and the obstacles often move in rhythm with the beat. This makes playing the game feel almost like dancing with your fingers. Instead of simply jumping over obstacles, players are following the music and trying to synchronize the…

Fun fact: I played it when I'm still an elementary school kid. I found this game when my classmate showed me this in the canteen. I played on Normal-Hard levels and die more often because I'm too young to understand, but now I can beat Extreme Demon, Bloodbath, one of my best achievement so far, then another (might take forever lol).

1253 hours. That's 1253 hours of jumping into spikes, dying at 98%, questioning my sanity, and somehow coming back for more.

Geometry Dash is genuinely one of the most addictive games I've ever played. The gameplay is simple to understand but incredibly difficult to master, and there's always something new to learn or improve at. Whether it's beating demons, grinding insane levels, improving your consistency, or spending hours in the editor, there's practically endless content.

The community is also a huge part of what makes this game special. The creativity behind some of the levels is genuinely insane, and seeing what people can create with the editor never gets old.

Of course, the game isn't perfect. Some levels are poorly balanced, certain difficulty ratings make absolutely no sense, and dying at the very end of a level can make you reconsider every decision you've ever made.

But despite all that, I keep coming back.

1253 hours later, I'm still grinding, still improving, and still finding new ways to suffer.
